boundary_conditions: dc_dy(0) = concentration_boundary_layer_thickness * contact_attachment_velocity * exp(-wall_shear_service / slime_adhesion_strength_new) / effective_near_wall_diffusivity * c(0)

parameters.name: concentration_boundary_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Near-wall transport layer of the order of the viscous sublayer, about 5*nu/u_tau = 5e-6/0.16 m = 3e-5 m at 12-16 kn, widened for the buffer layer.

parameters.name: effective_near_wall_diffusivity
parameters.justification: Effective transport coefficient of 5-20 um diatom cells near the wall (turbophoresis and eddy transport; Brownian diffusion alone is ~1e-13 m^2/s).

parameters.name: contact_attachment_velocity
parameters.justification: Wall-reaction velocity: contact frequency times initial sticking probability of diatoms on low-energy surfaces.

parameters.name: bulk_cell_concentration
parameters.justification: Coastal diatom concentration 1e3-1e5 cells/mL (1e9-1e11 per m^3).
